source_snapshot.criteria: Train to expected width and speed with no Errors
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual dependency but assumes Gen6 feasibility.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for positive Gen6 capability, Speed Change 46, Gen4 start, evidence and recovery.

old_problem: A full-width Gen4 start is this row's distinguishing state, while Gen6 feasibility depends on every physical and firmware element. A command option or final Gen6 snapshot proves neither condition.
disposition_reason: The Master completely defines direction, count and clean outcome. Positive Gen6 support, vendor primitive, path, limits and recovery can be signed runtime inputs. The review is resolved while the execution gate remains closed until both full-path capability and per-cycle Gen4-start proof are available.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2115, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2116 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00037-V002 / d9bb0c803597747a was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 46 uniquely requires 500 Gen4-to-Gen6 transitions; other start generations, Gen5 targets or reduced width cannot satisfy it.
Require positive Gen6/full-width capability for root port, switch, retimer, board/backplane, endpoint/GPU, firmware and pinned LTSSM/NVQual primitive.
Each transaction proves full-width Gen4 start before Gen6 request and records equalization/LTSSM, settle deadline, final width/speed, enumeration and error/health deltas.
If capability is absent, execution is BLOCKED; N/A requires authoritative SPEC. Never force or downgrade.
Preserve a monotonic 1..500 ledger and stop before the next request on unsupported mode, wrong start, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or gap.
Preserve first-fault evidence and use signed recovery without clearing or automatic retry.
No capability probe, LTSSM/NVQual, speed force/change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify five hundred genuine full-width Gen4-to-Gen6 transitions after authoritative full-channel Gen6 capability is proven.
required_package: Authoritative Gen6/full-width capability matrix for all path elements and firmware
Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 46 build, command and configuration
Approved per-cycle Gen4 entry and Gen6 equalization/LTSSM/settle/error rules
Dedicated SUT, 500-entry ledger/interlock, console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT FORCE OR EXECUTE until Project Configuration certifies Gen6/full-width support and binds Speed Change 46. After point approval preserve baselines and execute entries 1..500, proving Gen4/full width before each request and recording Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, errors and health before the next entry. Stop on first unsupported state, fault or gap; do not clear, downgrade or retry.
test_case.expected_result: With capability proven, all 500 entries independently show full-width Gen4 start and Gen6 settle within the signed envelope, required devices present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error and approved final health. Without capability, execution is BLOCKED.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until positive Gen6 capability, tool/path, Gen4-start method and limits are approved. PASS requires 500 complete accepted records. FAIL on force/mismatch, wrong start, failed/late/downtrained/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing capability/input/artifact is BLOCKED; N/A needs SPEC.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED without end-to-end Gen6/full-width proof.
Never force, downgrade or count a cycle lacking proven Gen4 entry.
Use only the approved primitive on an isolated SUT with console and stable power/cooling.
Preserve first-fault evidence and stop without retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and Gen6 capability matrix
Pinned Speed Change 46 tool/configuration and topology/lane/firmware map
Gen4-start plus Gen6 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen6/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final state, no-force/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported indication, invalid Gen4 entry, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit later requests and preserve the first event. Do not force, downgrade or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.
